title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 First Look Sneak Peek Released Ahead of October Netflix Debut – Watch
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is coming back this Fall with a whole new series, and Netflix has shared the first look clip showing off the intense action fans can expect to see in this sequel this October.

title: Singer, Composer Duncan Sheik Dies
content: Sheik wrote the music and lyrics for the upcoming American stage musical adaptation of Moyoco Anno 's Memoirs of Amorous Gentlemen ( Bikachō Shinshi Kaikoroku ) manga. Previews for his final musical open on Friday. The musical will then premiere for the general public in New York City off Broadway on October 15.
author: ANN

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime's 2nd Promo Video Reveals Theme Songs
content: The official website for the television anime of Shun Numa 's Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ( Chōjun! Chōjō Senpai ) manga revealed the second promotional video and theme songs. The trailer previews the opening theme song "That's! Chojo" by M!LK .

title: Tokyo Revengers Season 4 Drops First Look & Synopsis for Premiere Ahead of October Debut
content: Tokyo Revengers is ready for the beginning of the end, and now fans have gotten the first look at how everything is kicking off with the first look at story details revealed for Season 4’s big premiere.

title: Tokyopop's Public Stock Shares Offer Ends on September 24
content: Tokyopop announced on April 11 that it is offering public buyers to purchase stock shares of the company at US$5.00 per share with a minimum investment of US$1,000. The equity shares are Class B Common Stock, and they do not include voting rights.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Shares New Look at MAPPA’s Anime Comeback

title: Silent Witch Author Matsuri Isora Announces New Fantasy Novel
content: Matsuri Isora announced on Thursday that a new novel titled Bōkyaku no Curse Knight (Curse Knight of Oblivion) will ship on November 13 with illustrations by Shirotaka ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ).

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime Announces Ending Song Artists
content: The staff for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series announced the anime's ending theme song on Tuesday.
